inventory: The native inventory panel (mode 10) calls the binding match for slot 3 before the inventory close operation. The adapter can suppress this one check, leaving Escape and the opening binding intact.
camera: The game loop refreshes the scene at 0x46d16b after movement. The centering helper is 0x43a9e0. Actor stride is 0x1ab0, position is +0x20/+0x24, and the native walking branch checks +0x1670 == 1.
movement: The movement driver 0x44ed80 calls a destination-clamped vector routine and retains its native collision check and four axis fallback calls.
markers: Scene refresh stores category 9 object IDs 9000–9599 in the draw list at 0x6a55a8. Object stride is 0x490. Native object, visibility, and line-of-sight predicates constrain markers to resolved visible objects.
